items.title: Who Lived Behind These Walls?
items.task: Find two things that hide a house: a wall, a canal, a bent lane, a small gate.

question.text: Every samurai family here was rich.

items.title: Why Is Kanazawa Still Here?
items.task: This old town is not a rebuild after bombs. Why did it survive?
items.reveal: Several causes: luck, distance, later choices to keep streets. Do not pick one simple reason until checked.

items.title: Too Rich for Your Own Good
items.hook: The Maeda were rich enough to make Edo nervous.

moreInfo.title: Patronage
moreInfo.text: Wealth went into crafts and gardens as well as power. Avoid a cartoon of ‘hid gold so the shogun would not attack’ unless a source supports the exact claim.

items.title: Why So Much Gold?
items.task: Find gold leaf used in a slightly unnecessary way. Photograph it.

items.title: Gold You Can Eat
items.task: If you actually meet gold on ice cream or tea, say whether it tastes of anything.

items.title: Samurai City, Entertainment City
items.task: If you walk a chaya district, compare it with Gion: same job, different city.
